passives.name: Kakugono Susume
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Reduces Effectiveness of all enemies by 100 at the start of battle. Reduces damage taken by all allies from attacks that target all enemies by [Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_29_02]. When the caster is hit by an attack that targets all enemies, reduces the cooldown of Doujikiri Yasutsuna by [Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_29_03] turn(s).
